The selected pages of this section cover county registration and yearly licensing, first registration, titles and liens, renewal by mail and online, address and name changes on the registration, armed forces and disabled veteran exemptions, ownership documents for new and used vehicles bought in Hawaii, other states or abroad, temporary permits, license plate display and moped registration; they cover registration, titles and ownership documents and say nothing about any examination; they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: registration periods, document requirements and exemptions are statutory facts printed in this twenty twenty-three edition with no annual-rewrite signal on these pages.
